slots.text: Make the right buyers care about you and what you’re building.
We help Europe-based B2B AI SaaS founders turn their story and the business they’re building into LinkedIn content that attracts the right buyers, earns their trust and gives them a reason to buy.

topics.title: The customer problem behind the product.
topics.body: Explain the customer problem that made a product decision necessary. Give buyers the context they need to judge the trade-off.
topics.takeaway: Start with the problem. Show the decision. Explain what it changes.
topics.alt: The customer problem behind the product. Explain the customer problem that made a product decision necessary. Give buyers the context they need to judge the trade-off.

topics.title: A useful draft has a source.
topics.body: Before a draft is ready for approval, trace its product claims, examples and numbers. Keep permission and context with the source.
topics.takeaway: A clear voice starts with material the founder can stand behind.
topics.alt: A useful draft has a source. Before a draft is ready for approval, trace its product claims, examples and numbers. Keep permission and context with the source.

topics.title: Choose the format after the question.
topics.body: A short explanation can clarify a trade-off. A diagram can explain a sequence. A focused demonstration can show a workflow.
topics.takeaway: Choose the form that helps the reader understand the idea.
topics.alt: Choose the format after the question. A short explanation can clarify a trade-off. A diagram can explain a sequence. A focused demonstration can show a workflow.
